Se — extraverted sensing — delivers a fast, dense stream of what is physically present right now. The analysis is limited to what the object in front of you can confirm, and it is confirmed immediately. Troubleshooting logic: short feedback loops, little theory.

Where **Te** asks *"does it work?"* and builds external structures, **Ti** asks *"is it true?"* and builds internal coherence. Te trades elegance for speed; Ti trades speed for truth — a difference in what each is willing to pay, not in what each is capable of achieving.

One optimizes the judgment; the other checks the logic that produced it.

review.issue: The meaning of 'trusted' was changed to 'becomes familiar'.
review.back: On the second seat, Ti is consciously engaged instead of running by default. It edits rather than composes: what the dominant perception function—Ne's possibilities or Se's live readings—contributes is stressed for consistency before it becomes familiar. Precision on demand, at moderate cost.
The grid is displayed in a size of four-fifths and grows in sessions instead of continuously.
An ENTP presents six ideas and then silently dismantles four of them before anyone else can.

On the sixth seat, Ti turns inward as a fault-finder: sporadic, harsh examinations of its own logic – "your definitions don't hold" – which occur as judgments rather than as help. It checks more reliably than it constructs.
Short red flashes traverse an otherwise dimmed grid — inspection without construction.
An ISTJ reads through their own report once more at midnight and finds only shortcomings that are not specific enough to be corrected.

The eighth seat occurs least often and costs the most to manage. When it breaks out — usually at the end of a bad phase — it generates a cold pseudo-logic directed at the self: an argument for one's own worthlessness, disguised as objectivity. It is the least practiced seat in the stack, no hidden truth.
An inverted lattice that builds downward — a structure used for demolition.
At 3 a.m., an INFP compiles an absolutely airtight piece of evidence that every opportunity has been wasted, complete with supporting documents.

On the first seat, Ti runs without switching on: Every claim is tested against a private model of how things fit together, all day long, at low cost. Contradictions emerge early and cheaply. The price is the speed — a claim is not usable until it is consistent, and consistency takes as long as it takes.
CURRENTS depicts this as a grid in full size — large, fast and quiet, growing without visible effort.
A new paper will be read on Monday; nothing will be said until a conclusion arrives on Thursday that reorders the rest.

On the fourth seat, Ti costs the most per use and is used the least. In daily life, the person borrows others' frameworks instead of building their own; under sustained stress, the seat can take control and produce a rigid, all-or-nothing logic that doesn't sound like them — the outburst that Quenk refers to as a grip.
The grid draws small and slowly, with visible noise – connections fail and land hard, if they land.
An ESFJ who has been hosting all week suddenly argues literally over a technical nuance, in a tone that surprises both.

The fifth seat opens the shadow — the four positions that a person rarely and mostly unconsciously occupies. Here, Ti awakens fightingly: When the person's usual Te-logic is challenged, definitions are contested and the critic's logic is dismantled in order to protect the plan rather than to find out.
Below the waterline of the rail, the lattice fades and trembles, only coming together when touched.
An ENTJ whose rollout is being questioned spends ten minutes attacking the grammar of the question.

In the tertiary position, Ti is authentic but narrow: reliable in a few practiced areas, unreliable outside of them, and noticeably stronger with age. Under stress, it can pair with the dominant function to defend conclusions that no outsider is allowed to scrutinize—the pattern known as the Loop.
A half-grid, bright where it is used, and sparse everywhere else.
An ISFJ's home table is flawless; that same precision is never risked in a meeting.
